literal: At the time of not drinking liquor, when seeing an intoxicated person, will he not think of the degradation of his own drinking?
translation: When a man is sober and looks at someone who is drunk, will he not realize the utter degradation of his own drinking?
modern: மது அருந்தாத நேரத்தில், குடித்துவிட்டு மயங்கிக் கிடப்பவனைப் பார்க்கும்போது, ஒருவன் தான் குடிப்பதால் ஏற்படும் அவமானத்தை நினைக்க மாட்டானா?
explanation: This couplet offers a practical way for a drinker to reform. It suggests that when a person is sober, they should observe the shameful state of another person who is heavily intoxicated. Seeing the loss of dignity, speech, and self-control in someone else serves as a mirror. The observer will then inevitably realize the same degradation and embarrassment they themselves cause when they drink, prompting them to give up the habit.
